labels.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: flat rectangular full-wrap label texture for a cylindrical cleaning soap jug in a retro low-poly game. EDIT the attached existing label by OUTPAINTING HORIZONTALLY on BOTH SIDES. Preserve the existing front cover exactly as the sole central front panel: blue/cyan 2 matic front, blue drop/flower graphic, large navy 2 and red matic. Keep the same existing logo, typography, proportions, illustrations and palette; no full redesign, do not replace the brand. The original front should occupy the CENTRAL 18.5 percent of the full label width at full height, keep its original portrait proportions. Create a very wide panoramic strip, approximately 4.55:1 width to height. No mockup, no jug render, no perspective, no paper background, no margins. Extend matching colored graphic background left and right into realistic cleaning product packaging side/back panels with tidy small Spanish text blocks, usage icons, handling/caution symbols, ingredients/info, a barcode on a white box, batch box and recycling icon. The back is split between the leftmost and rightmost portions of the strip. Left and right outer edges must match in color/vertical bands for a clean single wrap seam. Exactly ONE front logo, never repeat the entire front. Keep crisp deliberately pixelated low-resolution game art consistent with the supplied cover, not high-resolution vector modernization. Preserve original visible front text and graphics rather than inventing a new label. New side text may read 'JABÓN DE LIMPIEZA', 'MODO DE USO', 'Aplicar sobre la superficie y retirar con un paño húmedo.', 'PRECAUCIONES', 'Mantener fuera del alcance de los niños.', 'No ingerir.', 'Conservar bien cerrado.', 'Contenido neto 5 L', 'LOTE'. The front stays as supplied, new information only on the extensions. Output one continuous 4.55:1 label strip.
